source: intelligence/unodc/NACS Strategic Pillars_National Dialogue on 9 November 2023.pdf
summary: Detailed breakdown of the 6 strategic pillars of South Africa's National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS), presenting high-level outputs and institutional mandates.

strategic_pillars.title: Citizen Participation & Whistleblowing
key_outputs: Feasibility study for a centralised whistleblower agency.
Strengthening organisational policies for whistleblower support.
Establishment of mechanisms for Beneficial Ownership transparency.
Review of PAIA to align with African Model Law on Access to Information.

strategic_pillars.title: Professionalisation
key_outputs: Chapter 13 NDP: Appointment reform and professionalisation of public service.
Competency assessments for senior public officials and SOE boards.
Ethics curricula integration in tertiary qualifications.

strategic_pillars.title: Good Governance & Consequence Management
key_outputs: Finalisation of lifestyle audit framework and implementation.
Database of public sector officials found guilty of fraud/corruption (DPSA).
Resource DPSA Ethics, Integrity, and Disciplinary Technical Assistance Unit.
Integrity promotion as a KPI in senior management performance contracts.

strategic_pillars.title: Procurement System Integrity
key_outputs: Strengthened debarment and blacklisting processes.
Research into incentivising whistleblowing in the procurement system.
Digital financial and procurement management system for open contracting.
Professionalisation of Supply Chain Management (SCM) occupations.

strategic_pillars.title: Anti-Corruption Agencies Resourcing
key_outputs: Establishment of an overarching anti-corruption coordinating body.
Improved systems for capturing and analysing relevant intelligence data.
Specialised training for investigators in cybercrime and economic crime.
Safeguarding budget and independence of investigative agencies.

strategic_pillars.title: Protection of Vulnerable Sectors
key_outputs: Sector-specific risk management frameworks.
Identification and auditing of most vulnerable state-owned entities (SOEs).
Collaboration between stakeholders to implement sector-specific AC strategies.

nacac_mandate: Advise on NACS implementation and Zondo Commission recommendations.
Advise on strengthening South Africa's anti-corruption architecture.
